collection.title: Hyundai ix20 2010 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Hyundai ix20 2010 - 2019 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 14" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this ix20, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
